newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kanematsu down on gloomy earnings forecast.
newsitem.headline: Kanematsu down on gloomy earnings forecast.

text.p: Shares in Kanematsu Corp fell in Monday morning trade, dragged down by a gloomy earnings forecast, brokers said.
As of 0155 GMT, the shares were down nine yen at 535 yen, on a trading volume of 569,000 shares.

Late last week, the trading house said it expected to write off 40 billion yen in the business year ending March 31, 1997, due to losses on financial investments and the winding up of some affiliates. It said it would post a full-year parent net loss of 20 billion yen, against its previous forecast of a net profit of two billion yen.
